propositions: Cancelled link delete operations are counted toward links_applied instead of being counted as failures, causing batch_outcome to report success for work that never occurred.

The root cause is missing --yes flag on workitem link create and workitem link delete commands, which causes acli to prompt for confirmation, read EOF from DEVNULL stdin, and report command cancelled deterministically on every pass.

The current exception handler in _update_one_dispatch_links treats all CalledProcessError as idempotent with no stderr check, silently converting cancellations into applied links without any failure log output.
The silent-noop canary REBAR_RECONCILER_FAIL_SILENT_NOOP cannot detect this divergence because it tests computed>0 and applied==0, but the miscounting inflates applied to equal computed.

A links_failed counter must be added to distinguish genuine idempotent failures (404/409 stderr) from other failures like cancellation, and --yes must be passed to both link subcommands to eliminate the prompt.
